reviews.title: 100% worth it!!
reviews.comment:
I was reluctant to spend more than $100 on a new case (since there are cheaper similar designs from other brands), but this is completely worth it!! I love the overall aesthetic, and there is plenty of room for cooling and larger gpus.
The materials are high quality and it is super sturdy. Building in this case is really easy as well, and it is very configurable. Only wish there was slightly more space for cables in the back.
Airflow is excellent - and one of the driving factors behind me picking it (my GPU was getting really hot in the old case).
One thing I was sad about is that if you want to flip the orientation of the case, you have to mount the motherboard upside down. I did all the work to orient the case so the glass would be on the right side just to find out that my computer hardware would be upside down, and I didn't like that look at all - so PSA for people wanting to do that.
I'm very happy I decided to go for this case, my computer looks so pretty in it and the airflow is keeping my GPU happy!

reviews.title: JUST... WOW
reviews.comment:
A ton of engineering and thought went into this case, end product is excellent, just too much to list.
Very elegant, heavy, this is not a flimsy tin soda can.  Only clear tempered glass offered with white case.
Not wanting a white case but wanting a clear glass this time, I purchased the white on sale.
Warehouse second chance at life item. No joke I am blown away, the white/black contrast is beautiful!
Easiest case to build to have the look/feel like it was a professionally built when your done. Mine will never be completely done as I keep tinkering/upgrading, but this case is something on another level, it is truly stunning. Arctic 420mm on top, 7600X, B650E Taichi Lite, 7900XT, (UPGRADED to GIGABYTE MASTER 5070Ti) Vertical mount GPU, De-Shroud QUIET/COOL Mod hack with 3 Arctic P12 Max butchered on with zip ties (its not even ugly)
TY Lian Li and Amazon second chance. I truly appreciate and thank you both !

reviews.title: Amazing Case!
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/B1mFm5NCi+L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/41IJzaIEM0L._SY256.jpg Let me start off and say; this case is amazing! It has so much room inside, a very nice design and look. plenty of HDD storage space hidden behind everything (If anyone still uses that of course). The LED strip around the case is the main "eye catching" part of it in my opinion. has so many different color patterns to choose from just with a button on the side of the case. All of the panels are quite easy to take off. One thing I will say about this case though, is that it is much bigger and heavier than I was expecting. This was my first PC build, but damn this thing is heavy. My whole PC weighs nearly 50 lbs.
